title: Twisted cantilever: transverse tip load
description: Same 90-degree twisted rectangular shell as in-plane companion.
geometry: 26 nodes; 12 elements. Same 90-degree twisted rectangular shell as in-plane companion.
material: E=2.9e+07, nu=0.22; shell thickness=0.32. Consistent benchmark units; displacements in deck length unit, forces in deck force unit, stress in force/length^2
boundary_conditions: Root clamped; unit total out-of-plane tip force along global Y.
loading: Total Fy=1 at the twisted free section (local out-of-plane bending).

references.citation: MacNeal, R.H.; Harder, R.L. (1985). A proposed standard set of problems to test finite element accuracy. Finite Elements in Analysis and Design 1, 3-20.
Ko, Y.; Lee, Y.; Lee, P.-S.; Bathe, K.-J. (2017). Performance of the MITC3+ and MITC4+ shell elements in widely-used benchmark problems. Computers & Structures 193, 187-206.

limits: Linear elasticity and small-displacement equilibrium or linearized bifurcation/modal analysis; this is computational verification, not a material-test validation.
figure_caption: Recorded JFEM result; deformation is amplified, mode amplitudes/signs arbitrary. Green triangles mark constrained nodes; magenta arrows mark available point loads.
